name: dev.forgesworn/402-mcp
description: AI agents discover and pay for Lightning and ecash payment-gated APIs within set limits

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a private 0600 file containing the Nostr Wallet Connect bearer URI. A raw NWC_URI is refused
environmentVariables.name: NWC_URI_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Path to the encrypted Cashu token store, within the home directory
environmentVariables.name: CASHU_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Path to the encrypted LNURLcash (LUD-25) bearer note store, within the home directory
environmentVariables.name: LNURLCASH_NOTES

environmentVariables.description: Most a single automatic payment may cost, in sats. 0 disables auto-pay
environmentVariables.name: MAX_AUTO_PAY_SATS

environmentVariables.description: Automatic spend allowed in any rolling 60 seconds, in sats. 0 blocks all auto-pay
environmentVariables.name: MAX_SPEND_PER_MINUTE_SATS

environmentVariables.description: Automatic spend allowed in any rolling 24 hours, in sats, persisted across restarts. 0 blocks all auto-pay
environmentVariables.name: MAX_SPEND_PER_DAY_SATS
